config.justenoughstructures.title: Just Enough Structures
config.justenoughstructures.browser.abou: How the browser opens. It also remembers these as you change them in it.
config.justenoughstructures.server.about: For worlds you play or host from this game, saved in config/justenoughstructures/server.json5. A dedicated server has its own copy of that file.
config.justenoughstructures.hidden.toolt: Left out of the browser, previews, locate and loot search. Use a structure's id, or modid:* for every structure from a mod.
config.justenoughstructures.hidden.inval: Not a structure id or modid:*
config.justenoughstructures.locate.toolt: The recovery compass button that finds the nearest one. In singleplayer, cheats on counts as an operator.
config.justenoughstructures.teleport.too: Ctrl-clicking the recovery compass button to go there. In singleplayer, cheats on counts as an operator.
config.justenoughstructures.show_loot.to: Off hides the loot markers and opening chests in the preview. What the loot can be is still listed.
config.justenoughstructures.edit.tooltip: Edits are saved as overrides in config/justenoughstructures/loot_overrides and apply after /reload.
config.justenoughstructures.container_ch: Off leaves every structure's containers as its mod made them, from the next /reload. The changes are kept and used again when it's back on.

screen.justenoughstructures.editor.title: Editing %s
screen.justenoughstructures.editor.statu: The table as the mods have it. Saving makes your version an override.
The mod's table has changed since you edited it
The mod no longer has this table. Your version still defines it.
Your saved version can't be loaded, so the mod's table is used. Fix it and save.
screen.justenoughstructures.editor.formu: This uses a formula. Edit it as JSON.
screen.justenoughstructures.editor.not_i: A %s entry. Edit it as JSON.
screen.justenoughstructures.editor.other: Also has %s more functions or conditions, kept as they are

screen.justenoughstructures.editor.save_: Saves your version as an override. It's used from the next /reload.
Saves, then runs /reload so it's used straight away
screen.justenoughstructures.editor.rever: Starts again from the mod's table
Showing the mod's table. Save to use it, or remove the override.
screen.justenoughstructures.editor.remov: Turns the override off from the next /reload. A copy is kept.
screen.justenoughstructures.editor.merge: Brings the mod's changes into your version. Where you both changed the same thing, yours is kept. Check it before saving.
screen.justenoughstructures.editor.keep_: Keeps your version as it is and stops flagging it, until the mod changes the table again
screen.justenoughstructures.editor.merge: Merged. You both changed %s things, and yours were kept. Check it, then save.
screen.justenoughstructures.editor.no_ba: There's no copy of the table you edited from. See the changes and edit by hand.
screen.justenoughstructures.editor.fix_j: Fix the JSON before going back to the form
screen.justenoughstructures.editor.unsav: Your changes to this table haven't been saved.
